exposure: Senning procedure complications (heart failure, arrhythmias, systemic tricuspid regurgitation)
surgical replacement of systemic tricuspid valve (sTV)
synchronous pacing with epicardial leads of CRT
outcome: positive remodeling of the systemic (morphologic right) ventricle (sRV)
reversal of further decline in systolic function
ability to carry out a twin pregnancy
cohort: A unique case of a female patient who developed complications after a Senning procedure for complete transposition of the great arteries (TGA).
finding: A female patient with severe complications post-Senning procedure was successfully treated with sTV replacement and CRT, leading to recovery of systolic function, positive sRV remodeling, and the ability to carry out a twin pregnancy, maintaining NYHA Class I two years postpartum.
